name: Decoupled Toolbox
description: Contains common features for decoupled websites.
project_description: Decoupled Toolbox exposes Drupal content as JSON to external or internal rendering services, driven entirely by Field UI. Installing it creates a Decoupled (id: decoupled) view mode on every fieldable content entity type; the fields you place on that view mode, and the decoupled field formatters you configure on them, define the JSON that a GET request to /decoupled-api/{entity_type}/{bundle}/collection returns. A query-string filter syntax (offset, limit, display and filter[i][f|v|c]) wraps entity queries so site builders can page and filter without code. A location solver lets each field relocate its value anywhere in the JSON tree (with token support). The module ships a matching REST resource, an events layer (query alter, processable check, rendered-output alter) for developer extension, and optional sub-modules that add decoupled formatters/behaviours for Comment, Color Field, Duration Field, Weight and Redirect, plus Group / Group Content Menu endpoints and an OpenAPI documentation generator. The maintainers note the module is aimed at server-to-server delivery and that the permission system still needs to be enforced before serving public frontends directly.
